fields.asset_name: Yunshan graphite mine and concentrator (Hegang / Luobei)
fields.asset_type: open-pit crystalline graphite mine and concentrator
fields.operator: China Minmetals Group (Heilongjiang) Graphite Industry Co. (五矿石墨)
fields.end_market: battery (natural-graphite anode feed) and high-purity products

rows.notes: Largest Chinese graphite mine. Mine: 6,000,000 t/yr ore ('年产600万吨矿石', S1; 'six million tonnes', S4); concentrator 200,000 t/yr concentrate ('20万吨精粉', S1, S3). Capacity recorded in t graphite (concentrate) = 200,000; ore capacity (6 Mt) is not a separate field. CONFLICT: Science and Technology Daily 2025-08-25 (S2) says 'year-production 280,000 t graphite concentrator' (年产28万吨石墨选厂); 2024 China Daily and 2026 Beijing News both say 200,000 t, so 200,000 used (28万 could be a later expansion or a different base; unresolved). Phase II (12 Mt/yr ore, S5, 2025-09) is being 'actively promoted' - undated, NOT counted. Reserves >1.5 bn t (S4, state media). installed_capacity = capacity because the sources describe the plant as 'built' (已建成) - no utilisation or production figure found (no 2025 output in open sources). Start year not found (company formed Dec 2019 per background in search text; mine consolidation 2019-2020). Hegang-wide figures in S4: 6.5 Mt ore capacity, 1.1 Mt 'refined graphite powder' (not used; sums several firms, unclear basis). Coordinates not taken. S4 publication date: URL path says 2026-05-13, page text 2026-05-15.

fields.asset_name: Minmetals Graphite spherical and high-purity graphite plant (Hegang, Heilongjiang)
fields.operator: China Minmetals Group (Heilongjiang) Graphite Industry Co. (五矿石墨)

rows.notes: S1 (2026-08-15): '年产5万吨球形石墨、5万吨高纯石墨项目' listed among things 'built' (已建成). CONFLICT: S2 (2025-08-25) says 'year-production 100,000 t spherical graphite and 80,000 t high-purity graphite lines' built; a recruitment page (search text only) also says ~100 kt spherical 'basically built'. The two Chinese state/news sources disagree by 2x; the more recent, 50,000 t, is used, 100,000 t not recorded. High-purity graphite (50 kt per S1, 80 kt per S2) is a separate product, not counted in capacity. Whether the 5万吨 is built-and-running vs project ('项目') is not clear, so installed_capacity left null. Exact plant location (Hegang industrial / graphite high-quality-utilisation park) not confirmed.

Mine permitted capacity 0.5 Mtpa of ore (annual graphite mining capacity); 'unprocessed graphite' extracted 255,500 t (2019), 211,200 t (2020), 258,300 t (2021) - 2021 recorded as latest found (production_year 2021, NOT 2025). fields.asset_name: China Graphite Group spherical graphite processing plant (Yanjun Farm, Luobei)
fields.operator: China Graphite Group Ltd (HKEX 2237) operating subsidiary in Luobei

rows.notes: Reported tier. 2022 technical-report text: upgrade expected to complete by 2022, raising spherical graphite capacity to 6,500 tpa (prospectus plan: 6,000 t spherical + 10,000 t micro powder). Sales (not production) of spherical graphite and by-products: ~8,300 t (2019), 10,400 t (2020), 13,800 t (2021) per prospectus text in search results; FY2024 sales 3,089 t, down 52.0% (S16, summary). Sales of 13.8 kt > 6.5 kt capacity suggests the sales figure includes by-products/micro-powder or the capacity is outdated; not reconciled. No 2024-26 capacity figure found.
